newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bodies found in German sausage maker's car boot.
newsitem.headline: Bodies found in German sausage maker's car boot.

text.p: German police said on Thursday they had found two bodies in the boot of a car belonging to a wealthy sausage manufacturer and his wife who disappeared from their home on Monday.

A spokesman for police in Bochum, western Germany, said they had found the body of man and a woman, but did not confirm whether the dead pair was Peter Schulte-Berthold, 43, and his wife Christine, 37.
Police had discovered traces of human blood in their house in Witten, and a large pool of blood in the garage. Two plane tickets to Budapest were found lying on the kitchen table.
The grey Mercedes car was found in Dortmund.
Schulte-Berthold was managing director of Zimmerman sausage factory, part of an extensive holding company of 18 firms.
